name: Picadillo
summary: Ground beef cooked with potatoes, carrots, and tomato, served over rice. Mexican home cooking that stretches a pound of beef.

ingredients.name: russet potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes

instructions: Cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the beef with the onion for 8 minutes, breaking it up.
Add the garlic, cumin, oregano, and chili for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes, carrots, tomatoes, 1 tsp salt, and 250 mL water. Cover and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Uncover and simmer a few minutes more until saucy rather than soupy. Serve over the rice.

glutenFree.notes: Beef, vegetables, rice, and spices are naturally gluten-free.

budgetNotes: The potatoes and carrots are there to make 450 g of beef feed four. That's the point of the dish.
Some families add raisins or green olives. Use them if you have them.
Also good as a filling for tacos or stuffed into baked potatoes.
